findings.summary: The calculator's main result ("66,5...") is cut off behind the round up-arrow button, so the reader can't read the full figure.
The calculator shows only one result, for withdrawing early after 5 years. There is no figure for 6 years or later, which is the case the reader actually plans for.
The "123 ממקור, 123 מחושב" labels are confusing and their meaning is not explained.
The tax-ceiling part (15,712 / 20,566 ₪) is unclear, and it doesn't say whether it matters to someone who earns less.
Terms such as "דמי ניהול", "אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה" and "מזומן שקלי" are not explained, and it's unclear whether to change the "תשואה בשנה 7" input.

The paragraph under the chart says 50,719 reaches the account and 15,794 comes back only if you ask for a tax refund. This doesn't match "נשאר בידיים" (66,5…), and the reader didn't know they would have to file for anything.
The fine print gives a range across 11 tracks (66,601 to 66,280) that doesn't match the main result (66,513), which leaves the reader unsure which number is right.
The cost section's line "הוצאות ישירות... לא נמצאה תקרה כוללת" isn't explained, and the reader can't tell whether it's bad.
The top bar chart has no legend for its grey, yellow and teal parts, no numbers on the bars and no y-axis.
The page doesn't help choose a track: which one to pick, and which one the fund's default is.
